name: Media Bulk Upload: DropzoneJS
description: Allows DropzoneJS integration with media bulk upload.
project_description:
Media Bulk Upload enables content editors to upload multiple files at once and automatically creates media entities for each file.

 There's an option to use DropzoneJS 

to quickly upload multiple files.

 Usage 
 
 Create new media bulk upload configuration settings /admin/config/media/media-bulk-config 
 Note: 

* Upload location (temporary) setting may be 'public://', 'temporary://' or 'private://'

 Please consider security implications of setting temporary upload location to 'public://' 

 * Maximum file size is currently determined based on the selected media

type with the highest maximum upload size.

 * There's an option to select form mode to populate media fields

 
 Bulk upload file page: /media/bulk-upload

 Media Library Bulk Upload (allows inline editing)
